files.name: useAdminAuth.md
files.summary: Role-based permission helpers for admin pages. It derives computed booleans from the workspace role returned by the admin API.

files.summary: Client helpers for installing and uninstalling extensions (plugins, themes, and admin plugins) from the admin dashboard.

files.name: useAdminPlugins.md
files.summary: Extension registry for the admin dashboard. Plugins register admin pages and widgets that appear inside the admin UI.

files.summary: Type definitions shared by the admin dashboard API responses. These are types only — no runtime code.

files.summary: Global workspace selection state for admin pages. Super admins use it to pick which workspace they are operating on.

files.name: useAiSettings.md

files.name: useApiError.md
files.summary: Consistent extraction of user-friendly messages from API errors.

files.name: useAuthTokenBroker.md
files.summary: Client-side token broker registry. Auth providers register a factory that can mint provider-specific tokens (for example Convex JWTs), and app code requests them by provider id.

files.name: useChatAttachmentDisplay.md
files.summary: Helper composable that prepares chat input attachments for rendering. It takes the raw attachment list and splits it into image and PDF buckets with stable display indexes.

files.name: useChatInputBridge.md
files.summary: Lightweight registry that lets external features (pane plugins, slash commands, automation) inject chat messages into an existing chat input without duplicating business logic.

files.name: useChatInputTheme.md

files.name: useChatMentions.md

files.name: useClientSessionRecovery.md

files.name: useCommandPalette.md

files.name: useCommandPaletteShortcut.md
files.summary: Global keyboard handler for the command palette. It binds Cmd/Ctrl+K to open the palette and Escape to close it, then prewarms the search module during idle time.

files.name: useComposerActions.md
files.summary: Composer action registry powering the quick-action buttons beneath the chat composer. Lets plugins add buttons that hook into the active editor, thread, or pane context with visibility and disabled logic.

files.name: useConfirmDialog.md
files.summary: Shared confirmation dialog controller. Any component can open a modal confirm and await the user's choice as a promise.

files.name: useDashboardPlugins.md
files.summary: Dashboard extension hub that lets first- and third-party features register launcher tiles, lazy-loaded pages, and capability flags for the retro dashboard. It centralises plugin discovery, page resolution, and in-app navigation state.

files.name: useDefaultPrompt.md
files.summary: Central helper for tracking the default system prompt across chat panes. It wraps the kv table, keeps a singleton ref of the active prompt ID, and fires hooks when the default changes so other modules can react.

files.name: useDocumentAiActions.md
files.summary: Registry for Document AI prompt commands. Plugins contribute / commands shown in the Document AI composer.

files.name: useDocumentAiAgent.md

files.name: useDocumentAiSettings.md
files.summary: Persistence and defaults for Document AI agent preferences. Settings are stored in the Dexie kv table and sanitized on every read.

files.name: useDocumentationContent.md
files.summary: Loader for documentation markdown pages. It fetches / documentation/<slug .md files for the /documentation routes.

files.name: useDocumentationNavigation.md
files.summary: Sidebar navigation for the documentation viewer. It builds category/group/item trees from the docmap and tracks which groups are expanded.

files.name: useDocumentationToc.md

files.name: useDocumentEditorSessions.md

files.name: useDocumentEditorToolbar.md

files.name: useDocumentHistoryActions.md

files.name: useDocumentInsights.md

files.name: useDocumentsList.md

files.name: useDocumentsStore.md

files.name: useEditorExtensionLoader.md

files.name: useEditorInspectorPanels.md

files.name: useEditorToolbar.md

files.name: useExtensionManagement.md

files.name: useHeaderActions.md

files.name: useHookEffect.md

files.name: useIcon.md

files.name: useLazyBoundaries.md

files.name: usePostsList.md

files.name: useServerRestart.md

files.name: useSidebarThemeProps.md

files.name: files-util.md

files.name: files.md

files.name: projects.md
